title: Table 2.7 Building separation to adjoining property boundary (MR2, HR1, HR2, HR3)

rows.note: up to 4 storeys: refer 2.4 side and rear setbacks (Table 2.1) and 3.5 visual privacy (Table 3.5)
adjoining property coded R60 or below
adjoining property coded R80 or above (R100-SL read as R80 or above; verify)

notes: Applies to MR2, HR1, HR2 and HR3 only. The extract interleaves the 9m, 6m and 'Refer 2.4 ... and 3.5' cells; read per C4P2-075 (5 storeys and above: 9 m to R60 or below, 6 m to R80 or above; up to 4 storeys: no number). An adjoining property with no R-coding (commercial, POS, road) matches no row and is NOT_APPLICABLE: 'coded' is undefined for uncoded land (C4P2-075). Both keys must be known for a lookup, so an up-to-4-storey case with no adjoining.r_code is CANNOT_TELL rather than NOT_APPLICABLE.

verified.note: as A2.7.1-r1: rows apply to MR2, HR1, HR2, HR3 only; up-to-4-storeys is a merged 'Refer 2.4 (Table 2.1) and 3.5 (Table 3.5)' cell; uncoded adjoining land and R100-SL are not placed by 'coded R60 or below / R80 or above'.
